coverage: All 26 displayed string locations route through their appropriate prose/table or inline-code serializer.
HTML entity order, Markdown punctuation, backslash parity, literal entities and Unicode preserve supplied text in the tested contexts.
CRLF emits one prose break; lone CR and LF cannot create document structure. Code-span line breaks normalize to spaces.
Code delimiter selection and padding preserve empty, all-space, significant-padding and mixed-backtick values.
All code-context fields are outside GFM tables, so raw pipes inside these spans cannot split table columns.
Numeric values, timeline meaning, missing cells, JSON and typed comparison input remain consistent with their data sources.
Diff stays within Markdown helpers and render_markdown; render_json and simulation behavior are unchanged.
review.verdict: No production defect found in the pinned renderer. Nine new report tests and all fourteen existing career-lab tests pass. The original source-format compatibility failure is resolved by the pinned root-authored test update.
review.integrationGate: Root must preserve reviewed source/test pins in its integration and perform its established exact-head gates. Artifact owns independent API/download/GFM/Chromium evidence.
